1.w: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of the chosen of God and the knowledge of the truth that [is] according to godliness,

2.w: upon the hope of eternal life, which God, who [is] without falsehood, promised before times eternal

3.w: and revealed [in] His own seasons in His word, in the proclamation with which I was entrusted according to the command of God our Savior.

4.w: To Titus, [my] genuine child according to a common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.

5.w: For the sake of this I left you in Crete, that you might set in order the things lacking and might appoint elders in every city, as I directed you,

6.w: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having believing children, not under accusation of debauchery, or insubordinate.

7.w: For it is necessary for the overseer to be blameless, as God’s steward—not self-pleasing, not prone to anger, not given to wine, not a striker, not greedy for shameful gain,

8.w: but hospitable, a lover of good, sound-minded, righteous, holy, [and] self-controlled,

9.w: holding to the faithful word according to the teaching, that he may be able both to exhort in sound teaching and to convict those contradicting [it].

10.w: For there are also many insubordinate ones, empty talkers, and mind-deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,

11.w: whom it is necessary to silence, who overturn whole households, teaching things [that] it is necessary not [to teach], for the sake of shameful gain.

12.w: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans [are] always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.”

13.w: This testimony is true, through which cause you are to rebuke them severely, so that they may be sound in the faith,

14.w: not giving heed to Jewish myths and commandments of men turning away from the truth.

15.w: All things [are] pure to the pure; but to those being defiled and unbelieving, nothing [is] pure. But both their mind and conscience are defiled.

16.w: They profess to know God, but in works they deny [Him], being abominable and disobedient and unfit for any good work.
